android_mechanism: Re-download/re-import performed without checking whether the data is already up to date; fix checks first and skips
bug_description: Opening the dataset sync page unconditionally re-downloads the full classic-poem dataset JSON and re-runs the bulk import, even when the (static, versioned) dataset is already fully imported. Every re-import re-attempts thousands of inserts that all conflict with existing rows (id primary key), wasting network transfer, parsing, and database work on each visit.
fix_summary: Before importing, a single COUNT query checks whether the dataset is already present and skips the download/import entirely when the table is populated.
trigger_steps: Import the dataset once via settings (数据同步) so the poem table is populated.
Start hitrace capture (categories: app, sched, network, disk, database).
Open the 数据同步 page again.
Stop hitrace after 10 seconds. Repeat 3 repetitions for unfixed, then install the fixed HAP and repeat 3 repetitions.

test_oracle.definition: Wall time of the case action, measured in the app.
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed re-downloads the whole dataset and re-attempts all inserts (visible network transfer + DB activity); fixed performs one COUNT and no transfer. unfixed network bytes >> fixed (fixed = 0).

oracle_revision.previous_definition: Bytes downloaded and database statements executed when re-opening the sync page with data already imported, plus page-open wall time.
oracle_revision.corrected_definition: Wall time of the case action, measured in the app.
oracle_revision.reason: The declared metric includes page-open wall time, which the collected elapsed time is. The declared metric also names bytes downloaded and database statements, which are NOT collected and remain open.

trace_config.command: hdc shell hitrace --time 15 app sched network disk database -o /data/local/tmp/jingmo_reimport.chtrace
